messages.subject: Project Drake — legal DD enquiries (1st request)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Following our review of the data room, please find our first list of legal due diligence enquiries below. Priority items: (1) the Stratton Energy supply agreement and any change-of-control provisions; (2) the Clydesford Bank facility and its consent requirements; (3) the freehold title and any environmental reports for the Long Eaton site; (4) the historic product warranty claim referenced in the board papers.

Full list in the enclosed schedule on the portal. Grateful for replies in the next 10 working days.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500 | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Drake — legal DD enquiries (1st request)
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Replies and supporting documents now uploaded to the data room (folders 4–9). In summary: the Stratton agreement does contain a change-of-control termination right (we'll seek consent); the Clydesford facility requires lender consent on a change of control; the asbestos survey for Building C is in folder 7 and is managed under a plan; and the 2024 product claim was settled for £18,500 with no admission. Shout if anything needs follow-up.

Marcus
